tests.name: Source reuse and scope
tests.required_assertion: Current API paths/commits recorded; no inferred full-repo absence from sparse checkout.

tests.name: Isolation
tests.required_assertion: Active Helm/Q4 source, old receipts, protected files and unrelated dirty work remain untouched.

tests.name: Separate state meanings
tests.required_assertion: Readiness, ASOM/region, semantic verdict and diagnostic availability cannot silently replace each other.

tests.name: Typed measured provenance
tests.required_assertion: Each live measurement has independently produced source, units, window and policy; invalid origin is refused.

tests.name: Absent evidence
tests.required_assertion: Missing/invalid telemetry remains UNASSESSED; no green default, uniform profile or fabricated measurement.

tests.name: Supported executable board
tests.required_assertion: Only named supported runtime operations execute; a static PCBA PASS alone confers no execution semantics.

tests.name: Exact numeric boundaries
tests.required_assertion: 12/4=3 and 12/6=2; zero-divisor, NaN, infinity, overflow and scale mismatch yield named refusals.

tests.name: Residual identity
tests.required_assertion: No residual compares different units/windows or calls inferred resistance an independent observation.

tests.name: Separate predicted and executed work
tests.required_assertion: Suppressed executor can have a nonzero allocation but zero observed execution, and is not successful control.

tests.name: Full accounting
tests.required_assertion: Failed checks, retrieval, controller overhead and canceled work already executed stay charged.

tests.name: Actual actuator
tests.required_assertion: Control change provably changes the registered executor action, not only a display field.

tests.name: Hard masks
tests.required_assertion: Prohibited routes stay unexecuted under large or invalid V; empty ready set does not normalize to a route.

tests.name: Shares vs total
tests.required_assertion: Common score scaling preserves shares; total-work change requires its separate policy; integer grants conserve the cap.

tests.name: Temporal order
tests.required_assertion: New verification/diagnosis cannot retroactively alter a route; intents apply only via lawful commitment.

tests.name: Exact parent resume
tests.required_assertion: Nested repair preserves caller, goal, input, context, branch, return point and spent budget.

tests.name: Wrong repair refused
tests.required_assertion: An unrelated, invalid or stale method cannot satisfy the required prerequisite.

tests.name: Bounded recursion
tests.required_assertion: Repeated prerequisite signatures, max depth/branches and work exhaustion terminate with precise reason.

tests.name: Invalid Effect
tests.required_assertion: Positive flow or Aligned status cannot cause acceptance of an independently rejected Effect.

tests.name: Atomic update
tests.required_assertion: Rejected or interrupted commits cannot leave partial authoritative Bias; rollback does not refund work.

tests.name: Actual native episode
tests.required_assertion: Recorded blocked->acquire->qualify->resume->verify chain uses real runtime calls, not a scripted answer.

tests.name: Budgets and negative witness
tests.required_assertion: Insufficient cap produces non-completion; no budget reset on subgoal or resume.

tests.name: Restart and reuse
tests.required_assertion: Fresh process replays the same committed state; new-input reuse and explicit invalidation both behave correctly.

tests.name: Positive and negative instrument controls
tests.required_assertion: Known workable route passes, disabled/wrong route fails; an invalid instrument cannot issue a benefit result.

tests.name: Atlas event binding
tests.required_assertion: Every executed edge binds an actual accepted event; hypothetical edges stay distinct.

tests.name: Focus isolation
tests.required_assertion: Flower/graph focus and coordinate-reference changes do not alter runtime, budget, original source or answer.

tests.name: Profile and child probes
tests.required_assertion: Unassigned profile remains missing; identical display totals do not erase differing child measurements.

tests.name: Replay tamper handling
tests.required_assertion: Truncated, wrong-version or inconsistent journal/snapshot cannot yield an authoritative-looking successful view.

tests.name: Existing Q4 evidence
tests.required_assertion: Saved first-error and assisted/free metrics preserve original scores and study verdict; no new model run implied.

tests.name: Real frozen model
tests.required_assertion: Actual neural call, checkpoint/source/codec and unchanged weight identity recorded; no scripted/compiler prediction substitution.

tests.name: No target side channel
tests.required_assertion: Strict reading has no gold AST/prefix/target cache; compiler-assisted mode is explicitly a different hybrid task.

tests.name: Action changes the model task lawfully
tests.required_assertion: A repair is a real permitted information/method/capacity change, not the same deterministic call renamed.

tests.name: Fair comparisons
tests.required_assertion: Fixed, generic-adaptive and CAS conditions have same information/actions/components/caps; task groups are bound before results.

tests.name: Resource contract
tests.required_assertion: Named priced bounded jobs, all-services reserve and no concurrency/preemption violation; no endless retry.

tests.name: Complete outputs
tests.required_assertion: Every scheduled task/model/condition has prediction or explicit failure; no best-seed selection or dropped failures.

tests.name: Teardown
tests.required_assertion: Final provider/owned-resource status and cost records are retained; a silent watcher is not cleanup.

tests.name: Honest result
tests.required_assertion: Implementation, control, task benefit, CAS-specific evidence, retention and release status remain separate; original negatives preserved.

blocking_rule: affected stage only if failure affects correctness, measurement, custody, budget or preserved work
